data.name: Atmoz Restore AB
data.description: Atmoz Restore AB is the carbon-credit/offset arm of the Swedish Atmoz group (parent Atmoz AB, Stockholm), which provides carbon management software and consulting. Atmoz Restore curates and resells a portfolio of third-party climate projects — both carbon removal (e.g. biochar via Creturner, Boreal Mix Swedish forestry) and avoidance credits — to corporate customers, and retires credits on their behalf. It is a broker/reseller, not a CDR project developer.
